label: ethicist at institution
definition: Person X works or worked as an explicitly identified ethicist or bioethicist affiliated with institution Y.
scope_notes: Includes: explicit ethicist or bioethicist at/for/of institutional role; historical ethics professional affiliation. Excludes: director, professor, fellow or other office without an ethics role; generic discussion of ethics; being an ethical person rather than a professional ethicist. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: unclear role or institutional attachment; a specialty subject replacing the employing or affiliated institution. Bioethics is a specific field within professional ethics. The relation does not evaluate the truth of ethical claims or infer an ethicist title from another academic office.

facts.reason: Dr. Arthur Caplan → University of Pennsylvania: Explicit ethicist-at and bioethicist-at titles establish the named institutional ethics affiliation.
